claims.text: The architecture of the span detector includes a Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) and a binary classifier for unanswerable questions.
The span detector and binary classifier share the same lower layer, which consists of a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer.
The span detector employs a multi-turn answer module to enhance its performance.
